name: Wedding Planner (Luxe)
tagline: A romantic, editorial template for wedding planners — book consultations from day one.
description: An elegant, romantic wedding-studio site — a soft-ivory palette, a dusty-rose primary and a champagne-gold accent, with editorial wedding photography carrying the page. Installs online booking for planning consultations, planners you book by name as bookable resources, and a booking-deposit policy. Ships as "Ever After Events", a luxury full-service wedding planner.
